items.title: Super scams First Guardian, Shield cause compensation cost blowout
items.description: The First Guardian and Shield super disasters, and Dixon Advisory fallout, is causing a cost blowout in the taxpayer-funded scheme that is designed to compensate victims of financial misconduct.

items.title: Foreign nationals deported after reaching Far North Queensland by boat
items.description: The federal government says a group of foreign nationals has been removed from Australia after reaching Far North Queensland illegally by boat this week.

items.title: NSW sergeant 'snuck a look' for ex-cop mate accused of domestic violence
items.description: A NSW Police officer has admitted to unlawfully accessing the force's internal database to locate details about a domestic violence complaint against his friend.

items.title: World's biggest porn site puts advertising block on Australian AI empire
items.description: Australian pornography website OurDream has had its advertising suspended by Pornhub after the ABC revealed OurDream's content could include child exploitation material.

items.title: Influencers to be targeted in crackdown on gambling advertising
items.description: The Albanese government will target social media influencers and individuals who promote gambling on social media as part of its proposed laws restricting advertising.

items.title: As they mourn their daughter, family wants a ‘life for a life’ from accused man
items.description: The family of a Thai teenager allegedly killed by an Australian man has placed her cremated ashes to rest at a local Buddhist temple as they seek justice for her murder.

items.title: Polling whets Labor's appetite for reform
items.description: The slight recovery in Labor's polling shifts assumptions about what's in store for the remainder of this parliamentary term.

items.title: Australians caught between homelessness and the law
items.description: For Australians on the brink of homelessness, dilapidated boats have become a way to stave off sleeping on the streets, but many are being removed from these vessels amid a safety crackdown.

items.title: Live: USA's World Cup dream alive despite red card against Bosnia and Herzegovina
items.description: The US seals progression to the last 16 with a 2-0 win over Bosnia and Herzegovina despite losing a man to a red card, while Belgium converts a penalty in extra-time to beat Senegal 3-2. Follow live.

items.title: Homeowners face tougher conditions than era of 17pc interest rates, analysis finds
items.description: Who had it tougher on housing? These stats may put the generational debate to bed.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
